introduction: Explore five complete building floorplate sheets and three separately attributed home-preview images, with full-size zoom and original-source links.
selectorLabel: Choose a complete building level or broker home preview
note: Five complete building sheets show the ground, first floor, paired even floors 2/4/6/8, paired odd floors 3/5/7/9 and roof. Basement drawings and separate detailed developer home-type sheets are absent. Three freely displayed broker images add a studio and two 1 BR previews. Preview resolution varies. No numerical saleable area is printed on these images, and the visible position 16 does not establish a contractual unit number. Confirm the selected home and final area with Imtiaz.
